svg.aria-label: Animation: 198 boxes for three shops are loaded into a 6.1 m truck, last stop first, then unloaded stop by stop through the door. The planner loads 198 of 198 boxes, a careful loader by hand 176.
svg.title: Load Planner
svg.text: Where every box goes, and in what order to load it
Loading: the last stop first, deepest in; every box fully supported
All 198 boxes in one 6.1 m truck, 2,462 kg
Stop 1, Marisett Electronics: its boxes are by the door
Stop 2, Dunhollow Home Centre: nothing else has to move
Stop 3, Brightwater Stores: the last boxes out
Empty: one trip, no box moved twice
